blog_title: Tiruppur to Delhi T-Shirt Transport Cost ₹25 — Real Supply Chain Breakdown for Bulk Buyers
caption:
300 dark navy tees ruined in one monsoon rain. A printer stacked fresh dyed shirts without drying—humidity hit 85%, dye bled everywhere 😬

We learned the hard way: monsoon fabric care isn't optional. The ₹10 fix? Soak in vinegar water for 15 minutes. Vinegar locks dye permanently inside the fiber.

Dark colors 15 min, light colors 10 min. Never stack wet.

Save this if you're bulk printing before monsoon hits 👇
